import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(top_breeds))
top_breeds.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dog Gender Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
colors_gender = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(gender_counts, labels=gender_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=colors_gender, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax2.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Dogs per District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors_district = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(district_counts))
district_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax3, color=colors_district)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District (Kreis)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Dog Age Distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Filter out invalid ages and create bins
dog_ages = df[df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0]['AlterVHundNum'].dropna()
bins = [0, 2, 5, 8, 12, 20]
labels = ['0-2 yrs', '3-5 yrs', '6-8 yrs', '9-12 yrs', '13+ yrs']
age_groups = pd.cut(dog_ages, bins=bins, labels=labels, include_lowest=True)
age_counts = age_groups.value_counts().sort_index()

colors_age = sns.color_palette('YlOrRd', len(age_counts))
age_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=colors_age, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
